{{Top|leg}}
A '''magnetohydrodynamic engine''' was a type of propulsion [[Engine/Legends|engine]]. Installed aboard the [[DeepWater-class light freighter|''DeepWater''-class light freighter]], the magnetohydrodynamic engine provided thrust that allowed the ship to travel [[Water/Legends|underwater]].<ref name="SS">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>
